{"id":1895962136,"question_id":4171,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 4 weeks","timestamp":1769310513,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"39 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1895962136/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Rotate Non Negative Elements","memory":"306.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> rotateElements(vector<int>& nums, int k) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        vector<int>positives;\n        for(auto it : nums) if(it >= 0) positives.push_back(it);\n\n        if(positives.empty()) return nums;\n        int m = positives.size();\n        int shift = (m - (k % m)) % m;\n        \n        reverse(positives.begin(), positives.end());\n        reverse(positives.begin(), positives.begin() + shift);\n        reverse(positives.begin() + shift, positives.end());\n\n        vector<int>ans(n);\n        for(int i =0 ; i< n ; i++){\n            if(nums[i] >= 0) ans[i] = INT_MIN;\n            else ans[i] = nums[i];\n        }\n\n        int idx = 0;\n        for(int i =0 ; i< n ; i++){\n            if(ans[i] == INT_MIN)\n            {\n                ans[i] = positives[idx++];\n            }\n        }\n    return ans;\n        \n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"rotate-non-negative-elements","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1555}
